comments: Andy Batten-Foster is the guest host.
After the FNC a mystery single is played with a prize offered to anyone writing in with the singer's name!

sessions.details: recorded for John Peel's Radio Show 7th February 1974.

transcript.text: I'm not going to try and fool anyone into thinking that I'm Tommy Vance. I'm Andy Batten-Foster, but this is The Friday Rock Show.
Tonight, new releases from some of the best of today's rock performers from Saxon and Robert Plant through to Zero and Earthshaker.
Add to that some classic music from Caravan in the archive session and plenty to think about in the Friday Night Connection.
Maybe we'll even make a few connections of our own tonight. We'll have to see how the evening unfolds.
But one thing I can promise you, we're going to have fun tonight.
